name: Chang’e, Prime Phoenix of the Blood Moon
description:
When the eclipse swallowed heaven’s light, Chang’e shed her immortal shell and was reborn as the Prime Phoenix — half dragon, half goddess, the eternal mirror of the moon’s fury. Her ascent marked the turning of cycles: a hymn of rebirth painted in crimson and silver.

Through the silence of the void she rises, wings like silk blades of light, her hair flowing in black lunar fire with a single silver strand glinting beneath the dying moon. Upon her chest, the lunar crystal burns with red reflection — the heart of a star that forgot mercy. And in that moment between shadow and dawn, Chang’e becomes not a goddess of peace, but the echo of celestial balance itself.

attributes.value: Long black flowing hair with single silver-lunar strand
Molten feather ribbons fading from red to white
Ceremonial dress gradient from crimson to lunar white
Lunar crystal on chest reflecting the blood moon
Mixed lunar white and eclipse red glow
Pure black void with blood-red moon
Four clawed fingers on each hand
